headline: Brazil's Tenda Uses Prefabricated Alea Unit to Counter Proposed Workweek Cut
summary: Brazilian homebuilder Tenda plans to eliminate operational drag from proposed 6x1 workweek changes via its Alea subsidiary. Half of Alea's production occurs in off-site factories without Saturday operations.
why: Construtora Tenda is a major Brazilian affordable housing builder. Changes in labor legislation affect construction timelines and cost structures across the homebuilding sector.

impacts.name: Construtora Tenda SA
impacts.why: Industrialized construction methods aim to buffer operating margins against potential labor regulatory shifts.
